rationale: Rerun in the same term: PREMBAT's plain INSERT hits the PREMIUMS primary key (-803), counts an error, keeps the first run's row, stops fetching (Q-35) and ends RC 4. premiumRecalculationJob upserts on (policy_number, coverage_seq, term_effective_date), so the rerun replaces the row and counts it as updated (AB-523). First-run rows are unchanged: the prembat goldens still match exactly.
